faqs.q: What are stock footage keywords and why do they matter?
faqs.a: Stock footage keywords are exact search phrases for platforms like Pexels, Storyblocks, or Envato Elements. Better keywords mean faster finds and fewer wrong clips—saving hours in post-production.

faqs.q: Why is B-roll important for viewer retention?
faqs.a: B-roll acts as a visual pattern interrupt over talking-head or voiceover audio. Fresh visuals every few seconds reduce boredom and help average view duration—key for YouTube growth.

faqs.q: How often should visuals change in a YouTube video?
faqs.a: Many modern edits cut, zoom, add text, or insert B-roll every few seconds—especially for mobile viewers. Use Zetawala B-roll ideas as a checklist so each script section has a visual plan.

faqs.q: Can this tool help with AI video generation prompts?
faqs.a: Yes. Along with stock footage keywords, Visuals Recommender outputs scene-ready AI prompts you can paste into tools like Runway or similar text-to-video apps when stock libraries fall short.

faqs.q: What should I use before the Visuals Recommender?
faqs.a: Write the narrative with Script Master (and Hook Architect for the open), then generate B-roll ideas and stock footage keywords here. Finish packaging with Title Generator and Thumbnail Prompt.
